description: Header file defining the NetworkChangeNotifierFuchsia class for monitoring network changes on Fuchsia OS, including interface event handling and connection type retrieval.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierFuchsia
classes.description: Class for monitoring network interface changes and connection type on Fuchsia OS, inheriting from NetworkChangeNotifier.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierFuchsia
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the notifier, optionally requiring WLAN interfaces.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: GetNetworkInterfaceCacheInternal
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal network interface cache.

methods.name: OnInterfacesEvent
methods.description: Handles network interface events from the watcher.

methods.name: HandleCacheStatus
methods.description: Notifies observers of cache status changes and unbinds watcher on error.
